reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: California
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: "Is it specified what must be included on the summons?"
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario (facts) and scenario_statement/0
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

scenario_state(california).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_document_type(summons).

% The user's question, encoded as a scenario "issue" we want to resolve.
scenario_issue(specified_required_inclusions_on_summons).

scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(california),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_document_type(summons),
    scenario_issue(specified_required_inclusions_on_summons).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  CA Civ Pro Code  412.20 (2021)
  Encodes that a summons must contain specified items, and be directed to
  defendant, signed by clerk, issued under seal, plus the enumerated contents.
*/

% Applicability: this statute governs "summons" content in CA (focus year 2021).
statute_cpc_41220_applies(california, 2021, summons).

% Required inclusions/attributes on a summons (enumerated content).
%  412.20(a): "a summons ... shall contain: (1)-(6)"
statute_cpc_41220_required_summons_inclusion(title_of_court).                 % (a)(1)
statute_cpc_41220_required_summons_inclusion(names_of_parties).               % (a)(2)
statute_cpc_41220_required_summons_inclusion(direction_to_file_pleading_within_30_days). % (a)(3)
statute_cpc_41220_required_summons_inclusion(notice_default_and_possible_relief).        % (a)(4)
statute_cpc_41220_required_summons_inclusion(bold_statement_may_seek_attorney_advice).   % (a)(5)
statute_cpc_41220_required_summons_inclusion(bold_intro_legend_english_and_spanish_notice_you_have_been_sued). % (a)(6)

% Other required attributes (not "contain" list but still specified in  412.20(a)).
statute_cpc_41220_required_summons_attribute(directed_to_defendant).
statute_cpc_41220_required_summons_attribute(signed_by_clerk).
statute_cpc_41220_required_summons_attribute(issued_under_seal_of_court).

%  412.20(b): counties may require additional foreign language legend by ordinance.
% We encode the conditional possibility as a rule driven by facts (none asserted here).
county_ordinance_requires_additional_language(_County, _Language) :- fail.

statute_cpc_41220_optional_additional_language_legend_required(County, Language) :-
    county_ordinance_requires_additional_language(County, Language).

%  412.20(c): a summons in a Judicial Council-approved form is deemed compliant.
statute_cpc_41220_deemed_compliant_if(judicial_council_approved_form).

/*
  CA St & Hwy Code  1167 (2021) - unrelated to summons content, but included.
  1167: boundaries established by the board remain until changed as provided.
*/
statute_shc_1167_rule(boundaries_of_division_remain_until_changed_as_provided).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning helpers
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% True when there exists some statute (in this dataset) applicable to the scenario
% that specifies required inclusions on a summons.
statute_specifies_required_inclusions_on_summons(State, Year) :-
    statute_cpc_41220_applies(State, Year, summons),
    statute_cpc_41220_required_summons_inclusion(_SomeInclusion).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Final answer predicate (deterministic)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    statute_specifies_required_inclusions_on_summons(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it specified what must be included on the summons?
